name: AIFarm, Ltd.
summary: AIFarm, Ltd., a development-stage enterprise, specializes in developing and implementing a distinctive growing system. This system involves the global design and construction of tailor-made biodomes, which are utilized by a wide array of clients, including large-scale commercial agricultural operations and smaller, independent local producers. Established in 2012, the company was previously known as Eco Energy Tech Asia, Ltd. until it rebranded as AIFarm, Ltd. in January 2020. Its corporate headquarters are located in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
